svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Skids: two 60 x 60 x 3 tubes 1,000 long, 520 apart (centres).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cross tubes: four 50 x 50 x 3 tubes 460 long between the skids,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tops flush with the skid tops, centred 25, 405, 670 and 975

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the lever end of the skids. Weld all round.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Base plate 12 mm, 315 x 340, on the two middle cross tubes,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 380 to 695 from the lever end; 8 x 13.5 holes for the core

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: feet and 2 x 11 holes for the guard feet (see the plan).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lever bracket: two 10 mm plates (EPR-DWG-102), inner faces

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 120 apart, standing on the end cross tube; weld both sides.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rest stop: 30 mm round bar 120 long between the bracket plates.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ties: two 40 x 3 round tubes 358 long, ends slotted over the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bracket plates, other ends welded to 10 mm tabs 88 x 80.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Eject posts: two 10 mm plates 60 wide, 31 hole 536 above the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: base plate, 120 apart inside, welded upright on the base plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld with the bracket shaft and both tab holes on a dummy

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: core jig, so the bolts line up. Check: frame sits flat.
